utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing, and when do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — that’s a big help. We still need hands sorting donations and loading the truck, and if you can come by around 2, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 2 to help sort and load.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s check the most urgent things first—what’s broken, and do we have a list of supplies already?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can start a quick list of the broken stuff and check what supplies we already have.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we still need for the repair drive and make a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, thanks. I might’ve missed a few things, so a list would help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll make a quick list and bring it over soon. If you remember anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. I’m mostly trying to sort out who’s bringing what and whether we have enough hands for the pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a pickup or drop-off shift if that helps. And I can check in with a few neighbors about bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, have we decided what repairs we’re covering for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the list, but I heard the roof patch was one of the main ones. If you’ve got the latest, I’m happy to go with that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll check the latest list and confirm the roof patch. Anything else you think should be included?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you mean the repair drive? I heard folks are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community center today.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s the one — I’m heading over with a few tools myself. If you’ve got anything to spare, the community center’s the place to take it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I might have a wrench and some screws I can bring by later. Glad it’s all going to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—it's a really good chance to pitch in and help out. If you want, I can make sure your name gets added too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—please add my name too. I’d like to help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll add your name right now. I’m glad you’re joining us!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm you’re still okay to help, and let me know what you’d prefer to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still happy to help. I can take on pickup and drop-off if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving. Let me know what you need from me, and I’ll help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep it simple and send you the list of stuff we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll make sure we keep track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let me know the time, and I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—thanks for reminding me. I can help out; just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Could you help sort the donated tools by the porch?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools by the porch now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good chance for the whole neighborhood to pitch in—what kind of repairs are you organizing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly little fixes—patching, painting, and a few broken bits folks have been meaning to get to. I’m just trying to round up people and see who can help where.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds doable—I can help spread the word and see who’s good with painting or patching.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive already — it’s a good chance to pitch in and get things fixed up together. Want me to pass your name along?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, go ahead and put my name down. I’ll try to swing by a little later and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you to the list and let people know you’re coming later. Really appreciate it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use help sorting the donations and loading the bigger items. If you’re free, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Just let me know when and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to work around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m thinking we should start right after school lets out, maybe around 3:30, so families can swing by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work well—3:30 is perfect after pickup. Do you want me to help spread the word to the other parents?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m happy to help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — could you help me spread the word and remind folks to bring any broken items by this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and remind everyone to bring their broken items by this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need a tool for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m just trying to make sure we have everything lined up before I start, so I may take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — just give me a shout when you know what you need, and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where everything needs to go for the repair drive. What location are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Opal. Let’s start with Maple Street and work our way down the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—Maple Street first, then we’ll move down the block. I’ll keep track as we go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so, but can we confirm the time and what we’re bringing first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely—what time works best for you, and should I bring tools or snacks?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort and list the tools we already have, so we know what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort through the tools we have and make a list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on everything—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—last I heard, it’s still going on, and they’re collecting donations and tools for the fixes. I might’ve missed a change or two, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’ll check in and see if there’s anything I can drop off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — people are bringing things by this afternoon. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people seem pretty willing to help. I can swing by later and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Ira. I’d appreciate it if you checked by later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, I’ll stop by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to check in on that. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the drill and a box of screws if you have them. That should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ve got a drill, and I’ll grab a box of screws too. See you there.
